title: [MCR] Revo Mod
description: Economy System for Modded RolePlay Servers
body:
**[MCR] RevoRP Mod (Fabric 1.20.1)**
A roleplay-focused economy and identity mod with banks, wallets, ATM, custom denominations, and permissions for bankers.
## Features
### Economy & Currency
•Custom currency items (stack to 64):
◦Cents: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50
◦Dollars: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100
•Wallet + bank balances stored in cents (USD with decimal display).
•Automatic change handling when withdrawing from pocket.
•Bank storage supports USD + emerald blocks.
•Optional Auto Storage: converts USD into blocks when enabled.
### Wallet System
•Player wallet stored on the server.
•HUD shows wallet + pocket balance (USD format).
•Wallet GUI (owo-lib based) to check balances.
### Bank System
•Full bank commands (deposit/withdraw from pocket or wallet).
•Bank branch zones with proximity checks.
•Convert USD <-> emerald blocks.
•Auto Storage toggle per player.
### ATM System
•Placeable ATM block (rotates like a furnace).
•ATM GUI with:
◦Deposit from pocket / wallet
◦Withdraw to pocket / wallet
◦Amount input (supports 12.50 / 12,50)
•Works without bank zones (no branch required).
### Identity Cards and Bankers
•Identity Card item with holder/type info.
•Banker permissions based on player tags/team.
•Banker-only actions for bank/identity features where required.
